sources.title: PM 600 series Modbus Register List (PM_600_Modbus_list.pdf)
sources.note: PDF attached to the Schneider Electric FAQ

notes: Addresses are the register numbers of the register listing (Modicon numbering, 1-based): the address on the wire is the register number minus 1.

Values are 16-bit integers. Currents, voltages and powers are multiplied by 10 to the power of their scale group register (2020 current, 2023 voltage, 2024 power); the unit is the one shown. Frequency is in hundredths of a hertz.
Registers that exist only on the PM620 or PM650 say so in their description (minimum and maximum values, demand, date and time, alarms and logs are PM650 or PM620 and PM650 only).
Not in this map: the 4-register energy values (modulo 10,000 per register), date and time, the event and alarm tables and the file setup registers.

Demand registers 1701 to 1712 and the predicted and present power demands carry the same scale groups as the metered values; the average power factors at peak are percentages in the listing and are left unscaled.
